title: Spec-answer question text can flag paths the owner did not choose

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-153915-ab03 for S560 (discovered from S560):

Spec-answer question text can flag paths the owner did not choose
`rec.Decisions` and the slice's "Owner decisions (" lines hold the question as well as the answer (`decisionpaths.go:27,44-45`). So a path named only in the question or in an option not chosen is flagged too. An example is a placeholder like `landed-changed/ID.md`, which is in adj 404's title. PLAUSIBLE: I did not find a live run that shows it. The fix would scan only the text after "->" in each answer line.
